definition.en: A machine that uses steam to perform mechanical work.
definition.zh: 利用蒸汽做机械功的机器。

definition.en: The chamber in which a piston moves.
definition.zh: 活塞在其中运动的腔体。

definition.en: A close-fitting moving part acted on by pressure on its faces.
definition.zh: 在缸内运动、两面受到压力作用的零件。

definition.en: The difference between pressures on two sides.
The change from vapour to liquid.
definition.zh: 物质从气态变成液态的变化。

definition.en: A vessel separate from the working cylinder where exhaust steam condenses.
definition.zh: 独立于工作汽缸、让排出蒸汽凝结的容器。

definition.en: A pump that removes air and water from this condensing system.
definition.zh: 在这套冷凝系统中把空气和水移走的泵。

definition.en: Working strokes occur in both directions of piston travel.
definition.zh: 活塞两个方向的行程都能做功。

definition.en: Watt’s linked-bar arrangement giving an approximately straight piston-rod path.
definition.zh: 瓦特用连杆组合得到近似直线活塞杆路径的机构。

definition.en: A joint about which a member turns; it may be fixed or moving.
definition.zh: 杆件绕它转动的连接点；可以固定，也可以随机构移动。

definition.en: A rod-carried planet gear travels around a sun gear on the output shaft.
definition.zh: 传动杆带着行星轮，绕输出轴上的太阳轮运动。

definition.en: A wheel that stores and returns rotational kinetic energy.
definition.zh: 储存并交还转动动能的轮。

definition.en: A speed-sensitive mechanism that adjusts steam admission through a linkage.
definition.zh: 随转速变化、通过连杆调整进汽的机构。

definition.en: A valve that restricts the steam supply passage.
definition.zh: 限制供汽通道开度的阀。

definition.en: A path by which an output affects the input that drives it.
definition.zh: 输出反过来影响驱动它的输入的路径。

definition.en: Energy transferred by the component of a force along a displacement.
definition.zh: 力沿位移方向的分量所传递的能量。
